classification_rule: edge_present_at(level) = verdict in {REGIME_STABLE, REGIME_DEPENDENT} and all per-segment net-of-cost medians > 0; COST_ROBUST = edge at zero+realistic+stress; COST_SENSITIVE_AT_STRESS = edge at zero+realistic, lost at stress; COST_SENSITIVE_AT_REALISTIC = edge at zero, lost at realistic; NO_EDGE_AT_ZERO_COST = no edge at zero cost.

implementation_defect.description: momentum_signals computes mean(log(price)) over the lookback window (always positive for adjusted close > 1) and takes its sign, so it emits a constant LONG on every bar independent of lookback; mean_reversion_signals emits a constant SHORT. Neither implements the documented 'previous N-day return' hypothesis.
implementation_defect.evidence: probe: existing_momentum non-neutral bars all weight +1 (0 short) on AAPL/AMZN/JPM/XOM; corrected return-based momentum flips ~800-900 times over ~4.5k bars.
implementation_defect.implication: The prior 'momentum SUPPORTED' and 'reversal FALSIFIED' verdicts describe constant long / constant short (equity beta / drift), not a momentum/reversal signal; lookback 3/5/10 robustness is vacuous because the signal is identical at every lookback.
